newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aroma Liquor in talks to sell at discount.
newsitem.headline: Aroma Liquor in talks to sell at discount.

text.p: Aroma Liquor Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was in talks which could involve the sale of a controlling interest in the company at a substantial discount to Friday's closing share price of 224 rand.
It urged shareholders to exercise caution in their dealings.
